literal: He who fears his wife, who does not possess the next life, his action-capability attaining greatness is not.
translation: He who fears his wife and has no hope of the next life will never attain greatness in the strength of his actions.
modern: மனைவிக்கு அஞ்சுகின்ற, மறுமைப் பயன் இல்லாதவனுடைய, செயல் செய்யும் ஆற்றலின் சிறப்பானது ஒருபோதும் விளங்குவதில்லை.
explanation: This couplet highlights the consequences of a man being subservient to his wife. The poet states that a man who lives in fear of his wife is like someone who has no share in the virtues of the next life. Such a person's capability and strength in executing actions will never achieve greatness or distinction. The key words 'வினையாண்மை' (strength of action) and 'வீறு' (greatness) emphasize that fear of one's wife paralyzes a man's capacity for noble and effective deeds.
